subject: Daz's Shape Water potential
fact: Daz's repeated overpromising on Shape Water has created doubt among the group, but this successful use raises questions about whether his ability was underestimated or if this was a rare true instance of his power.
source_quote: They have heard Daz explain how he can use Shape Water, and every time, the promise far exceeds what is delivered... But this time, he is confident.

subject: dragon god’s followers
fact: A theological thread explores how Bahamut, traditionally not seeking non-dragon faithful, has gained followers due to perceived divine actions in the chess narrative involving Protanther and Stroud.
source_quote: And so the dragon god, who was never one to seek faithful among those who were not dragons, has gained quite a following among those who saw in his actions a divine plan.
